top_examples.hook: My brother accused me of stealing Mom's wedding ring. She had sold it herself, and she let him blame me through the whole dinner.
top_examples.premise: A brother accuses his sister of stealing their mother's wedding ring while their mother conceals that she sold it to help the sister leave her marriage.
top_examples.title: Mom Hid Her Hand Through the Whole Dinner

top_examples.hook: The mechanic wouldn't return my car without my husband's permission. The car was mine, and my husband was using the delay to make me miss a job interview.
top_examples.premise: A mechanic refuses to return a woman's repaired car without her husband's permission because her husband wants her to miss an interview for a job away from home.
top_examples.title: The Mechanic Was Waiting for My Husband

top_examples.hook: At my promotion lunch, my boss announced my first task was to fire my dad. He expected me to do it with Dad sitting beside me.
top_examples.premise: At an employee's promotion lunch, his boss announces that his first responsibility as supervisor is to fire his own father to prove he earned the role.
top_examples.title: The Promotion Lunch Dad Couldn't Finish

top_examples.hook: Dad offered his house to whichever child took him in. Then he said Mom would have to live somewhere else. They were still married.
top_examples.premise: A father offers his house to whichever child takes him in but insists that his wife of forty years must live elsewhere while still providing weekend meals.
top_examples.title: Dad Offered the House, but Mom Wasn't Included

top_examples.hook: My groom called me selfish at the altar for refusing to quit my job and care for his mother. Then she asked what had happened to the nurse she'd hired.
top_examples.premise: A groom publicly accuses his bride of selfishness for refusing to quit her job and become his mother's full-time carer, although his mother has already arranged professional help.
top_examples.title: The Third Place at Our Dinner Table
